# Rashi on Kiddushin

רש"י על קידושין

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin)

דיוני חז״ל בנושאי הלכה, מוסר ותנ"ך שהתקיימו במשך דורות. בנויים כהרחבות על המשנה ושזורים בהם סיפורי אגדה.

Classic 11th-century commentary known for its concise and clear explanations and considered a key resource in studying Talmud.

Sections: Daf-Line-Comment

Location: Talmud/Bavli/Rishonim on Talmud/Rashi/Seder Nashim

## Daf 2a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:1)


האשה נקנית - לבעלה:


To her husband


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:2)


בשלוש דרכים - כדמפרש ואזיל והאי שלוש לשון נקבה הוא ובגמרא בעי אמאי תנא לשון נקבה:


As we will explain later on, "and these three are in female form." And the Gemara will ask why it's taught in feminine form.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:3)


וקונה את עצמה בשתי דרכים גרסי':


Our printing: And she "acquires" herself in two ways


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:4)


וקונה את עצמה - להיות ברשותה להינשא לאחר:


To be within her rights to marry another


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:5)


בכסף ובשטר - מפרש בברייתא בגמ' (לקמן קידושין דף ה ע"ב) נותן לה כסף או שווה כסף ואומר לה הרי את מקודשת לי שטר כותב לה על הנייר אף על פי שאינו שווה פרוטה הרי את מקודשת לי ביאה בא עליה ואמר התקדשי לי בביאה זו וכולהו יליף מקראי:


The Braisa explains in the Gemara (5b), [acquisition with money:] give her money or money-equivalent and say to her, "behold you are betrothed to me." Document: write it for her on paper, even though the paper is not worth a prutah, [say,] "behold you are betrothed to me." Through intercourse: come upon her and say "betroth me with this intercourse." All of this is learned from the [written] Torah.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:6)


טעמא דב"ש מפרש בגמ' (דף יא.):


Beit Shammai's reasoning is explained in the Gemara (11a)


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:7)


פרוטה - של נחושת:


of copper


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:1:8)


איסר האיטלקי - של כסף ודמיו שמנה פרוטות:


of silver and its value is eight prutas.



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:2:1)


היבמה נקנית - ליבם:


To the deceased husband's widow [yavam]


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:2:2)


בביאה - להיות כאשתו לכל דבר, שאם בא לגרשה אחר כך, אינה צריכה הימנו חליצה אלא גט. אבל שטר וכסף אין מועילין בה מן התורה, אלא מדרבנן דתקון דמהני בה מאמר, כדאמרינן ביבמות (דף נ ע"א). אבל אינו גומר בה להיות יורשה ומיטמא לה ולא לפוטרה מן החליצה, אלא לפוסלה על שאר אחיו:


To be his wife for all matters, for if he came to divorce her afterward, she does not need from him halitza rather a bill of divorce [get]. But money or a document do not have the effect of betrothing her from the Torah, rather from the Sages as they instituted an order, as they say in Yevamot. But (money or a document) do not finalize the betrothal to allow him to inherit from her or become impure for her and do not exempt from halitza, rather they make her forbidden to the other brothers.



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:3:1)


ומאי שנא התם - בפרק שני (לקמן קידושין דף מא ע"א) דתנא האיש מקדש בו ובשלוחו ניתני הכא האשה מתקדשת:


1 . And what's the difference there--In the second chapter (41a) where it says "the man betroths himself or with his agent," let it say here: the woman becomes betrothed


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:3:2)


משום דקבעי למיתני כסף - בהני קניינין ואמרינן לקמן (קידושין דף ד ע"ב) כסף מנלן דנקנית בו ומפרשינן דגמרינן קיחה קיחה משדה עפרון דאקרי קניין הלכך תנא הכא קניין:


2. Because it needs to teach money--that with [money] we aquire, and we said previous (4b) "from where do we know that we can acquire with money," and we explain that we learn "take" "take" from the Field of Efron that we consider it an acquisition. Therefore we learn here that [money] can acquire.



### Line 4

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2a:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2a:4:1)


וכסף מנלן - לאו הכא קא בעי לה אלא לקמן (קידושין דף ג ע"ב) והכא האי מתרץ קאמר לה לכולא מילתא משום דקא בעי למיתני כסף וכסף מנלן ילפינן ליה לקמן (קידושין דף ד ע"ב) מקיחה וקיחה לשון קניין הוא הילכך תני האשה נקנית:


And from where do we derive that [betrothal is accomplished by means of giving] money? - It is not here where [the Gemara] is asking [about the source for betrothal by money], but rather later on [Kiddushin 3b:4]. Here it is being used [in the course of] an explanation for the entire matter [at hand, namely]: because he wanted to teach [about betrothal through] money, and from where do we derive that [betrothal is accomplished by means of giving] money? We will derive it later on [Kiddushin 4b:3] from "taking." Since "taking" is a term for acquisition, the Mishna uses the expression "a woman is acquired."



## Daf 2b


### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:3:1)


וניתני הכא האיש קונה - כי היכי דתני בלישנא דרבנן האיש מקדש:


"And let it teach here: A man acquires" - so that it would be taught in the language of the Sages, [namely:] "A man betroths."



### Line 4

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:4:1)


וניתני - הכא האיש קונה בג' דרכים:


But let it be taught - In this case the man acquires in three ways.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:4:2)


ומקנה - אותה לעצמה בשתי דרכים. ומשני משום דאיכא בהנהו ב' דרכים מיתת הבעל:


And she becomes acquired - She for herself in two ways: And it answers, on account of there being in those two ways the death of the husband.



### Line 7

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:7:1)


בודקין את הזב – במאכל ובמשתה בחולי בקפיצה במשא ובמראה ובהרהור שמא מחמת אחד מהן ראה ואנוס הוא וטהור דרחמנא אמר (ויקרא טו) מבשרו מאיליו ולא מחמת אונס והאשה באונס נמי מטמאה כדאמר בפ’ בנות כותים (נדה לו:) כשהוא אומר כי יזוב זוב דמה הרי אונס אומר:


One examines a zav - with regard to food and with regard to drink, with regard to sickness, with regard to jumping, with regard to a burden, and with regard to a[n arousing] sight, and with regard to the thought [of a woman], in case he saw [the discharge] due to one of these [factors]. [Any of those] would make him a victim of circumstances beyond his control, and [thereby] pure. As the Torah says, "from his flesh" [Leviticus 15:2] -- [that is], on its own, and not due to [other] circumstances beyond his control. Whereas a woman becomes impure even due to circumstances beyond her control, as is stated in chapter "Samaritan Girls" [Niddah 36b:13]: "When the verse states: “And if a woman has an issue of her blood" [Leviticus 15:25], it is referring to circumstances beyond her control.



### Line 10

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:10:1)


ופרכינן מ"ט תני שלוש - משום דרכים קאמרת:


And [the Gemara] asks, what is the reason that the mishna teaches "Three" [shalosh, in the feminine] - are you saying because it wanted to teach "ways"?


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:10:2)


ליתני דברים וניתני שלושה - כי אורחא דגמרא:


Let it teach instead the word: "Matters" and let it teach three [shelosha, in the masculine] - as is typical for the Gemara.



### Line 12

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:12:1)


ותני תרתי משום חדא - בתמיה, שינה לשון כסף ושטר משום ביאה היה לו לילך אחרי הרוב:


And it was taught two because of one? - Surprising! To change the language (from male to female) of 'Money' and 'Document' for the sake of 'Intercourse'? He should follow the majority.



### Line 13

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:13:1)


הא מני - דתני לשון דרך בקדושי אשה ר"ש היא דאמר אורחא דארעא שייך בהו:


Who is this - That taught (in this) language (the way) of betrothing a woman? It is Rabbi Shimon, who says the way of the world applies to them.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:13:2)


אבידה - אחת מצלעותיו:


A Loss - (Referring to) one of his Ribs.



### Line 15

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:15:1)


בג' דרכים - ערלה ורבעי נוהג בו כאילן ולעניין שביעית הולכין בפירותיו אחר החנטה כאילן ולא אחר לקיטה כירק:


In three ways - just as with [other] trees, the laws of orlah and the fourth-year sapling apply to [an etrog tree]. With regard to the shemitta year, its fruit is reckoned, as for [other] trees, according to the time of its formation, and not according to the time it is picked, as with vegetables.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 2b:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/2b:15:2)


ולירק בדרך אחד - שבשעת לקיטתו - עישורו שאין הולכין בו לעניין מעשרות אחר חנטה כשאר אילנות אלא אחר שנה שנלקט בו כירק כדמפרש טעמיה לקמן. המעשרות משתנות כסדר השנים שנה ראשונה של שמיטה מעשר ראשון ושני וכן בשניה אבל שלישית מעשר ראשון ומעשר עני ואם חנט בשניה ונלקט בשלישית בשאר אילנות אחר חנטה ובאתרוג אחר לקיטה כירק:


And corresponding to those of a vegetable in one way - namely, that [the reckoning of its year for the purpose of] its tithes [are according to the time of] its harvesting. For the purpose of tithes, it is not reckoned according to the [year] of its [fruit's] formation like other trees, but rather according to the year in which it was picked, as with vegetables, for which the reason will be given below. Tithes differ over the course of the years: in the first year of the shemitta cycle, the first and second tithe [are taken], and so too in the second [year]. But in the third [year] -- the first tithe and the tithe of the poor. If the [fruit] formed in the second [year] and was picked in the third [year] -- with other trees, [it would be reckoned] according to [the year of] its formation, whereas the etrog [would be reckoned] according to when it was picked, as with a vegetable.



## Daf 3a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:1:1)


התם הא קמ"ל - דטעם דאזלינן ביה אחר לקיטה משום אורחא דמילתא הוא:


There, [the mishna] teaches us this - that the reason that we reckon [the etrog's year for the purpose of its tithes] according to the time of its being picked is because of its typical properties, [as follows:]


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:1:2)


מפני שדרכו ליגדל על כל המים - שמשקין אותו במים שאובין כירק דהיינו טעמא דירק כדאמר בר"ה (דף יד.) גורן ויקב כתיב גבי מעשר כדגן מן הגורן כו' מה גורן ויקב מיוחדין שגדלין על רוב מים דהיינו גשמים ומתעשרין אחרי השנה שעברה כדאמרינן בר"ה (דף יב:) דאזלינן בתר שנה שהביאו שליש בה ולא אחר לקיטתו וילפינן לה מקראי אף כל שגדלין על רוב מים דהיינו אילנות מתעשרין לשעבר ואע"ג דמעשר דידהו דרבנן הוא אסמכינהו אקראי יצאו ירקות שגדלין על כל מים מתעשר לשנה הבאה:


As it is its way to grow by [being watered by] all water - because it is watered by drawn water like a vegetable, which is the reason for [the rule for] vegetables [too], as is stated in Rosh Hashanah: [the terms] "threshing floor" and "winepress" are used regarding tithes, [as in] "as with the new grain from the threshing floor", etc. [Numbers 18:27]. "Just as [the grain that is brought to] the threshing floor and [the wine that is brought to] the winepress are special in that they grow on most water" -- that is, rainwater -- "and they are tithed in accordance with the outgoing year" [Rosh Hashanah 14a:7]. As we have stated in Rosh Hashanah, we reckon [the produce's year for the purpose of its tithes] according to the year in which it reach one-third of its growth [Rosh Hashanah 12b:12], and not according to when it was picked. We derive this from scripture: "so too, anything that grows on most water" -- namely, trees -- "is tithed in accordance with the outgoing year." (Even though their tithes are Rabbinic in origin, we ascribe this rule to scriptural verses.) "This comes to exclude vegetables, which grow on all water. Consequently, they are tithed in accordance with the incoming year." [Rosh Hashanah 14a:7]



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:1)


כוי - ספק חיה ספק בהמה:


Koy - it is uncertain whether it is [classified as a] non-domesticated or a domesticated animal.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:2)


יש בו דרכים כו' - דכיון דמספקא לן ניזיל ביה לחומרא:


There are ways, etc. - since we are in doubt, we treat it stringently.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:3)


שוה לחיה - וטעון כיסוי דם:


Correspond to a non-domesticated animal - and require covering of the blood.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:4)


ולבהמה - חלבו אסור:


And to a domesticated animal - [in that] their fats [chelev] are forbidden.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:5)


ושוה לבהמה וחיה - טעון שחיטה:


Correspond to both a non-domesticated animal and a domesticated animal - [in that] they require ritual slaughtering.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:6)


שאין שוה לא לחיה ולא לבהמה - אסור הרבעה עם בהמה וחיה:


Correspond to neither a non-domesticated animal nor a domesticated animal - [in that] it is forbidden to mate them with either a domesticated or a non-domesticated animal.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:2:7)


זו אחת מן הדרכים - שהמביא גט או שחרור ממדינת הים צריך שיאמר בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם בפ"ק דגיטין:


This is one of the ways - that one who brings a bill of divorce or manumission from overseas is required to state "it was written before and it was signed before me", [as taught] in the first chapter of Gittin.



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:3:1)


דאיכא פלוגתא - חילוק בדרכיו בדרך זו הוא דומה לכאן ובדרך זו אינו דומה כגון מתני' בג' דרכים למעוטי חופה דלא קניא ודזב הכי הוא דהוי אונס לזיבה ולא אונס אחר ודגטין באלו שוה ולא באומר תנו גט זה לאשתי ושטר שחרור זה לעבדי דחוזר בגט ואינו חוזר בשחרור דזכין לו לאדם שלא בפניו:


That there is a distinction - a distinction in its "ways", namely, that in this way it is like that thing, and in this way it is not alike. Such as, in our Mishnah, "in three ways" -- to exclude [betrothal through the] marriage canopy, which does not serve to acquire. Regarding the zav: it is thus [i.e., one of the seven ways] which is considered circumstances beyond one's control regarding the laws of zav, but not any other type of circumstance beyond one's control [which one would not be penalized for regarding other laws]. Regarding bills of divorce: in these ways they are like [bills of manumission], but not where one says "give this bill of divorce to my wife" or "this bill of manumission to my slave", since one may retract a bill of divorce but not a manumission, since one may act in a person’s interests in his absence.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3a:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3a:3:2)


דיקא נמי - דהיכא דלא הוי ליה פלוגתא תנא לכל דבר:


Is also precise - that where there are no distinctions, [as in the opinion of Rabbi Eliezer], the Mishnah uses expression "with regard to every matter."

חליפין איתנהו בפחות משוה פרוטה - דקי"ל בפרק הזהב (ב"מ דף מז.) קונין בכלי אע"פ שאינו שוה פרוטה:


Exchange is effective using less than the value of one peruta - as we have established in the chapter "The Gold": "One can acquire property [through a symbolic exchange] by using a vessel, even if it does not have the value of one peruta." [Bava Metzia 47a:16]



## Daf 3b

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 3b:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3b:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/3b:1:1)


לא מקניא נפשה - דגנאי הוא לה הלכך בטיל לה לתורת חליפין בקידושין ואפילו בכלי שיש בו שוה פרוטה אי יהיב לה בלשון חליפין עד דיהיב לה בתורת לשון קנין או קיחה או קידושין:


It does not acquire her soul - it is a disgrace to her; therefore the method of chalifin is abolished for her when doing kiddushin. And even with a vessel whose worth is greater than that of a pruta, if you bring it to her with the language of chalifin [it does not acquire her soul] until he brings her according to the laws with the language of acquisition or buying or kiddushin.

A document, with which one cannot redeem consecrated property - if he wrote a document to the treasurer drawing on the funds for redeeming consecrated property, his consecrated property is not thereby redeemed, since we require "he will give the money and it will be assured to him." From "karet" [versus] "keritut" - since it ought to have been written "sefer karet", meaning that the scroll severs her; this additional exposition is warranted by the more-elaborate term [that the verse employed, namely: "keritut"].



### Line 12

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 5a:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/5a:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/5a:12:1)


חדא מחדא לא אתיא כו' - הכי קשיא ליה האי תנא דלעיל דפריך בכולהו והלא דין הוא והדר דלא אתו מדינא ואצרכיה קרא למה לי קרא בכולהו נהי דחדא מחדא לא אתיא תיתי חדא מתרתי במה מצינו בהצד השוה שבהן שקונין בעלמא וקונין כאן אף אני אביא את השלישי שהרי כולם קונים במקום אחר כסף ושטר קונה באמה העבריה כדלקמן (קידושין דף יד:) ביאה קונה ביבמה:


One mode [of betrothal] cannot be derived from another [mode of betrothal], etc. - [the Gemara] asks as follows: the Tanna who earlier asked regarding each [method of betrothal] "can't it be derived using a logical derivation", and who then concluded that they cannot be derived logically, but require scriptural support -- why do we require scriptural support for each of them? Granted that one mode cannot be derived logically from another; but let one mode be derived from two others using the "just as we find in the common denominator of these" argument: that they are capable of acquiring in general and are capable of acquiring here [for betrothal]. "Then I shall even bring" the third [mode and derive its effectiveness from the other two]. All [three modes] are capable of acquiring in other circumstances: money and documents acquire a Hebrew maidservant, as will be stated later on [Kiddushin 14b] and sexual intercourse acquires a *yevama*.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 5a:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/5a:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/5a:12:2)

Money and intercourse; their benefit is great - but a document of betrothal does not have any benefit, all that is written in it is "you are betrothed to me".

Likewise, I will bring the mode of a wedding canopy, which generally effects acquisition - in that it completes [the acquisition as far as it pertains to the husband's rights] to inherit from her and to annul her vows. That they are effective against her will - that they serve to acquire in general: namely, intercourse [serves to acquire] a *yevama*, and a document in [the case of] divorce, and money in [the case of] a Hebrew maidservant.

## Daf 7a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:1:1)


ואקדש אני לך - וכשנתנו לו א"ל התקדשי לי מקודשת ואע"ג דלא מטי הנאה לידה:


And I will be betrothed to you - when he gives [the 100 dinars] to [the other man], he says "be betrothed to me" -- she is betrothed, even though she receives no benefit.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:1:2)


מדין ערב - ממה שמצינו בתורה שהערב משתעבד למלוה אנו יכולין ללמוד:


From the *halakha* of a guarantor - we can derive from that which we find in the Torah, that a guarantor becomes responsible to the lender.



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:1)


הילך מנה והתקדשי לפלוני - והוא שלוחו אלא שמקדשה משלו:


Here are one hundred dinars for you, and you become betrothed to so-and-so - and he [acts as] his agent, except that he is betrothing her using his own [money].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:2)


מקודשת - ואע"ג דממונא לאו של משלח הוא:


She is betrothed - even though the money does not belong to the principal.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:2:3)


מדין עבד כנעני - דתנן במתני' לקמן (קידושין דף כב:) קונה את עצמו בכסף ע"י אחרים שאחרים פודין אותו בממונן והוא קונה עצמו ויוצא לחירות ואע"ג דלא חסר איהו בהאי ממונא מידי:


From the *halakha* of a Canaanite slave - as is stated in a mishna later on [Kiddushin 22b:6]: "And he can acquire himself by means of money given by others" -- that others can redeem him with their own money, and he acquires himself and goes out to freedom, even though [the slave] loses nothing at all of his own money.



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:3:1)


ואקדש אני לו - לאותו פלוני במנה שתתן לו בשבילי:


And I will be betrothed to him - to the same so-and-so to whom you give the money on my behalf.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:3:2)


מדין שניהם - מבין שני הדינין הללו של ערב ושל עבד כנעני אנו למידין:


From the *halakha* of both of these - from both of these laws: we derive it from that of the guarantor and that of the Canaanite slave.



### Line 5

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:5:1)


האי דקא מקני - בעל העבד שהוא מקנה את העבד לחירות קא קני האי כסף שמקבל בפדיונו:


There, the one who transfers - the owner of the slave who transfers the slave into freedom is the one who acquires the money that he receives for the slave's redemption.



### Line 6

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:1)


ואקדש אני לך - והוא קיבלו ואמר לה התקדשי לי בכך:


And I will be betrothed to you - and he accepts [the money] and says to her: "you are betrothed to me with this."


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:2)


מקודשת - כדמפרש ואזיל טעמיה לקמיה:


She is betrothed - as [the Gemara] goes on to explain below.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:3)


שיש להן אחריות - אדם הוקש לקרקעות דכתיב (ויקרא כ״ה:מ״ו) והתנחלתם אותם לרשת אחוזה:


Property that serves as a guarantee - a person [in this case, the woman] is compared to land, as is written, "you may keep them as a possession." [Leviticus 25:46]


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:6:4)


עם נכסים שאין להם אחריות - שמוכר או נותן לו קרקעות ומטלטלין וזה מושך המטלטלין והקרקעות קנויים לו במשיכת המטלטלין:


With property that is not guaranteed - that one who sells or gives land and movable property, and the other pulls the movable property, and the land is transferred to him through the pulling of the movable property.



### Line 7

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:1)


ואנן איפכא תנן - שצריך לקנות הקרקע באחד מן הדברים שהקרקע נקנה בהן כגון כסף או שטר או חזקה דנעל וגדר ופרץ כל שהוא והמטלטלים נקנים אגבן:


But we learned the opposite - that it is necessary to acquire the land using one of the three methods by which land is acquired; namely: money, a document, or by taking possession. [Taking possession means] where he locked [the door of the property], or fenced it or breached [its fence even] a bit [Bava Batra 42a:9]. Then, the movable property is acquired by way of [the land].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:2)


באדם חשוב עסקינן - שאינו רגיל לקבל מתנות:


We are dealing with an important man - who does not usually [deign to] receive gifts.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:7:3)


בההיא הנאה כו' - שתרצה זאת לתת פרוטה לאדם שיפייסנו לזה לקבל הימנה מתנה:


Due to the benefit etc. - that she would want to give a *peruta* to someone who would flatter [the important man] into accepting a gift from her.



### Line 8

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 7a:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/7a:8:1)


וכן לענין ממונא - הנך שמעתא דרבא דילפינא קידושין מדין ערב ומדין עבד כנעני כן לענין ממונא מכר לו שדה ואמר לו תן הכסף לפלוני ושדי מכורה לך בו קנה מדין ערב הילך מנה ותהא שדך מכורה לפלוני קנה אותו פלוני השדה מדין עבד תן מנה לפלוני ותקנה לו שדי בו קונה מדין שניהם:


And similarly, with regard to monetary matters - this [entire] discussion of Rava's, in which we derive [the law of] betrothal from the law of a guarantor and from the law of a Canaanite slave -- it is likewise applicable to the matter of monetary transactions. If one sold a field to another, and said to him, "give the money to so-and-so and my field is sold to you" -- it is [indeed] thereby acquired, from the law of a guarantor. [If he said:] "Here is 100 dinars, and your field shall be sold to so-and-so" -- that so-and-so acquires it, from the law of a slave. [If he said:] "Give 100 dinars to so-and-so, and my field shall be sold to him" -- he thereby acquires it, from the laws of both of them.



### Line 9

התם בהמה היא - ושלו היא ואין מעכב על ידו מלהתקדש לפיכך יש כח במאמרו לפשוט והכא דעת אחרת יש חשובה כמותו המעכבת בדבר שאם אין אשה רוצה אינם קידושין וזו לא נתרצה אלא לחציה לפיכך אין דיבורו תפיס בה:


There, it is an animal - and it belongs to him, and there is nothing preventing him from sanctifying it. Therefore his utterance has the power to spread [the sanctification across both halves of the animal]. But here, there is another mind as significant as his which can prevent the thing -- since if the woman does not want it, [the money] does not work to betroth her. Only half of her was persuaded, so his words do not effect her [betrothal].

This case is comparable only etc. - [this passage serves as] the conclusion of the [Gemara's] reply [rejecting the possibility that the betrothal can spread to both halves]. This case is comparable only to that of an animal belonging to two partners, where there likewise is another mind that can prevent [the sanctification from spreading]. There, we did not say that the animal is fully sanctified by [the actions of] one of them.

It may not be sacrificed - since at the initiation of its sanctification it was not fit to be sacrificed, since only half of it was sanctified. It must be sold and another animal sacrificed using its value.

## Daf 11b

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/11b:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/11b:1:2)


ותנן שבועת הדיינין - אינה בפחות מטענת שתי מעות כסף ופליגי בה רב ושמואל רב אמר כפירה שתי כסף ושמואל אמר טענה עצמה שתי כסף ואפילו לא כפר בה אלא פרוטה או הודה בפרוטה חייב מ"מ מדקתני שתי כסף ש"מ קרא לאו דוקא כסף קאמר אלא אממונא בעלמא קפיד וכיון שלא פירש כמה לא מסרו הכתוב אלא לחכמים ולא קים להו לרבנן לאשבועיה בבציר מהכי דאי קרא דוקא כסף כתיב נהי דמעה היא מטבע הפחותה שבצורי מיהו שתים מנא להו:

הכי גרסי' ומה כסף דבר חשוב אף כלים דבר חשוב - שיהו שוים שתי כסף ולאפוקי ממ"ד התם טענו שני מחטין חייב בהודאת אחת מהן לכך יצאו כלים למה שהן כלומ' שיתחייב בכלים בכל שהו. ורבותינו מפרשים שהדינר הוא מטבע הפחותה שבצורי ופירכא מדקתני שתי כסף שהן מעות ותירוצא מה כלים דבר חשוב אף כסף דבר חשוב ומעה דבר חשוב הוא ולדידי קשיא ביה טובא חדא דא"כ דכל כסף האמור בתורה דינר הוא היכי אתיא הך היקישא ומפקא ליה הא כי אתא היקישא לאשמועינן מה כלים שנים אף כסף שנים הוא דאתא ועוד מה כלים דבר חשוב וכי מחט דבר חשוב הוא והא אמרינן התם לכך יצאו כלים למשהו אלמא לא חשיבי מחטים ועוד בהדיא אמרינן התם איפכא מה כסף דבר חשוב אף כלים דבר חשוב וכסף כי אתא להך דרשא אתא:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/12b:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/12b:12:2)


בשעת מתן מעות - אם קודם שקבלתן אמר לה התקדשי לי בו מקודשת דכי קבילתיה אדעתא דהכי קבילתיה:



### Line 13

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/12b:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/12b:13:1)


מכלל דרישא - דלא פליג בין רצתה ללא רצתה:



## Daf 13a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:1:1)

התם - גבי כנסי בפקדון מעיקרא בתורה שמירה קבילתיה כי הדר אמר התקדשי לי בו סברה אי שדינא ליה כו' הילכך לא שדתינהו והאי דלא מחאי משום דלא איכפת לה אבל גבי ציפתא מעיקרא בתורת קידושין קבלתיה ונהי דציפתא לית בה שוה פרוטה כי הדר ואמר תקדוש בזוזי דאית בה אי לא ניחא לה תשדינהו דהא לא נתחייבה בשמירתה ומדלא שדתינהו ש"מ נתרצית בקידושין:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:3:1)

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13a:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13a:9:1)

## Daf 13b


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:1:1)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:2:1)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:2:2)

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:1)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:2)


לאו דאורייתא היא - לומר דנכסוהי דאינש ערבין ביה ומשתעבדים מדין ערב ויהיו מלוה על פה ומלוה של שטר שוין אלא מלוה בשטר שהוא שיעבדו דכתב ליה נכסי אחראין לך משתעבדי מלוה על פה לא משתעבדי:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:3:3)


ור' אסי אמר כו' - והא נמי לנקוטינהו לשמעתיה אמרוהו התם:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:4:1)


הא פליגי בה חדא זימנא - הני אמוראי גופייהו שמואל ורבי יוחנן:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:4:2)


אינה גובה מן היורשין - דשיעבודא לאו דאורייתא וכ"ש מן הלקוחות אבל מלוה בשטר הוא עצמו שיעבדו דכתב ליה כל נכסיי דאית לי אחראין לשטרא דנן:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:5:1)


דלאו מלוה הכתובה בתורה - לא הוטל עליו חובה מאת המלך אלא מעסקי מעשה עצמו:


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:5:2)


אבל בהך - דיולדת דמצות המלך היא עליה אימר חמירא ככתובה בשטר:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:7:1)


דלית ליה קלא - ואיהו דאפסיד אנפשיה ואף על גב דשיעבודא דאורייתא עבוד רבנן תקנתא ללוקח דלא הוה ידע:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:8:1)


דכתיב וכתב לה ספר כריתות - וגו' והיתה לאיש אחר:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:9:1)


והוא שרי לה - כשאינו בעולם נפטרה הימנו שהרי בו היתה קשורה:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:10:1)


והא עריות - כגון אשת אביו וכלתו ואשת אחי אביו שע"י קדושי הבעל נאסרו לקרוביו וכשימות הבעל לא שרו להו שאסורות לקרוביו לעולם:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:1)

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:2)


האי עשה מאי עבידתיה - שיהא הוא עומד בפניה ואיסור לאו וכרת שבה פקעו:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:3)


אי אהני מיתת הבעל כו' ואי לא אהני - דאשמיעך קרא דאין מיתה משלחת:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:12:4)


תוקמה במילתא קמייתא - ולא איצטריך למיכתב לאו בכ"ג:

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 13b:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:13:1)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:13:2)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:14:1)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/13b:14:2)

## Daf 14a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 14a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14a:1:1)


יבא עליה ולקחה לו - כלומר ביאתה הן ליקוחיה:


Will engage in sexual intercourse with her and take her to him - that is to say, sexual intercourse with her constitutes taking her [as opposed to their being two separate things].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 14a:1:2

But perhaps [one can say that with regard to all matters] she is like a wife - just as with a wife, money and a document [act to bethroth] just as sexual intercourse; so too with a *yevama*, money and a document [act to betroth] just as sexual intercourse -- since it is written "[her brother-in-law will ... take her to him] as a wife" [Deuteronomy 25:5].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 14a:1:3

"And perform levirate marriage with her" - which connotes sexual intercourse. Scripture repeats it [another word with the root *YBM*] to preclude [any other forms of completing the levirate marriage].



### Line 2

Such is the proper reading: It is needed [to teach] that he can perform levirate marriage without her consent - which is how we expound [the verse] in Tractate Yevamot [Yevamot 8b:14].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 14a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14a:2:2)

If so - if [the verse] is to teach that sexual intercourse [is the only method of acquisition], let it say "and perform levirate marriage." What [then is connoted by] "and perform levirate marriage with her"? To derive that it can also [be done] against her will. This is taught explicitly in a baraita in Tractate Yevamot in Chapter "One who had Intercourse with his *Yevama*": "And perform levirate marriage" -- sexual intercourse completes her [acquisition], but money and a marriage document do not complete her [acquisition]. "And consummate the levirate marriage with her” -- [he acquires her even if he acted] against her will [Yevamot 54a:5].

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 14b:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14b:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/14b:2:4)

Or through the deduction of money - he can redeem himself; his master deducts the cost of his labor for the years that have already passed from the cost of his redemption, all according a calculation based on his purchase price. As it is written: "The price of sale shall be applied to the number of years" (Leviticus 25:50) -- if he bought him for six *Maneh*, and he is due to go [free] after six [years], it turns out that he acquires the labor of each year for one *Maneh*.

More than him - since she acquires herself with all these modes, as well as through signs indicating puberty, as we derived earlier (Kiddushin 4a:3) from "Then shall she go out for nothing." (Exodus 21:11)

וחכ"א כו' - חולקין עליו וזו ראיה שלהם קים לן דאין עבד עברי כהן נרצע מפני שנעשה בעל מום ולא יכול עוד לשוב לחיזוק הראשון ולקמיה ילפינן ושב אל משפחתו למוחזק שבמשפחתו והיאך הוא נעשה בעל מום והתנן (בכורות דף לז.) גבי מומין נפגמה אזנו מן הסחוס אבל לא מן העור:


And the Rabbis say, etc. - they disagree with [Yudan]. This is their proof: it is established for us that a Hebrew slave who is a priest is not pierced, because this would make him blemished, and he will no longer be able to return to his original status. Later on, we derive from "And he shall return to his own family” (Leviticus 25:41) -- to his status in his family (Kiddushin 21b:12). How then can he be rendered blemished? Did we not learn in a Mishna, regarding blemishes, "[the firstborn is considered blemished, and may be slaughtered outside the Temple] if the ear was damaged from the cartilage but not if the skin was damaged" (Bekhorot 37a:15).

He is pierced only, etc. - you may learn from here that we only pierce on the upper part of the ear.

דריש כללי ופרטי - בכל התורה מקום שכולל ופורט דורש שהפרט פירוש של כלל ואין בכלל אלא מה שבפרט וכי חזר וכלל לא הוסיף לך בכלל האחרון אלא הדומה לפרט:


Expounds generalizations and details - throughout the Torah, in a place where it generalizes and specifies, he expounds that the specification is an explanation of the generalization, and the generalization only includes what is in the specification. When [the verse] then goes on to generalize again, the latter generalization is only adding that which is similar to the specification.



### Line 9

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 21b:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/21b:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/21b:9:1)


ריבויי ומיעוטי - אין הפרט פירושו של כלל שתאמר אין בכלל אלא מה שבפרט אלא למעוטי הוא בא לפי שבכלל היה מרבה את הכל ובא המיעוט אחריו לומר בזה וכיוצא בו כללתי לך הילכך אפילו לא חזר וכלל הייתי מביא כעין הפרט וכי חזר וריבה ריבה הכל ולא מיעט לך אלא דבר אחד ומסרו הכתוב לחכמים איזה דבר הראוי למעט מן הכלל פי' מיעט ממעט קצת ממשמעו:


Amplifications and restrictions - [in his method of exegesis,] the specification is not taken as what is meant by the generalization -- that is, you should not say the general term only includes that which is in the specification. Rather, it comes to restrict -- the general term would have included everything, and the restriction comes afterwards to indicate that this, and things similar to it, were what I meant for you by the generalization. Therefore, even if [the verse] does not go on to state another generalization, I would have [known that the rule applies only] to bring things that are similar to the specification. If the verse then goes on to amplify again, it comes to amplify [and include] everything, and there is only one thing excluded. It was given over to the Rabbis to decided which thing was fit to be removed from the generalization. Thus "restriction" is interpreted to mean "restricted somewhat from its connotation."

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 22a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/22a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/22a:3:1)


ה"ג להאי ברייתא בספרי בפ' ראה אנכי ואם אמר יאמר עד שיאמר וישנה אמר בתחילת שש ולא אמר בסוף שש אינו נרצע שנאמר לא אצא חפשי עד שיאמר בשעת יציאה אמר בסוף שש ולא אמר בתחילת שש אינו נרצע שנאמר אם אמר יאמר העבד עד שיאמר כשהוא עבד. והכי פירושה אמר ושנה שתי האמירות בתחילת שש ולא אמר בסוף שש אינו נרצע שנאמר לא אצא משמע סמוך ליציאה אמר שתי פעמים בסוף שש כו' עד שיאמר כשהוא עבד:


Such is the proper reading for this *baraita* in Sifrei in Parashat *Re'eh Anokhi* (Sifrei Devarim 121:1): "But if he shall say" -- unless he says it and repeats it. If he said [it] at the beginning of his six [years of service] but did not say [it] at the end of six [years of service], he is not pierced, as it is stated: "I will not go out free"; unless he says it when he leaves. If he said [it] at the end of six [years] but did not say it at the beginning of six [years] he is not pierced, as it is stated: "If the slave shall say" -- unless he states it while he is a slave. And this is its interpretation: if he said, and repeated, the two utterances at the beginning of the six [years], and did not say it at the end of six [years], he is not pierced, as is it stated: "I will not go out," which implies close to the [time of] going out. If he said it twice at the end of six, etc. -- unless he says it while he is [still] a slave.



### Line 5

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 22a:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/22a:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/22a:5:1)


ה"ג אמר מר אמר בתחילת שש כו' מאי איריא מלא אצא חפשי תיפוק ליה דבעינן כו' ותו אמר בסוף ולא אמר בתחילת שש אינו נרצע שנא' העבד אטו סוף שש לאו עבד הוא. והכי פירושה אמר בתחילת שש כו' קס"ד תחילת שש ממש תיפוק ליה דבעינן אהבתי את אשתי ואת בני ועדיין בתחילת שש אין לו אשה ובנים שלא מסרו לו עדיין שפחה כנענית:


Such is the proper reading: The Master said: If he said [it] at the beginning of six, etc... Why specifically from "I will not go out free"? Let him derive [it from the fact] that we require, etc... And furthermore, [the *baraita* states that if he said it at the end and did not say it at the beginning of six he is not pierced, as it is stated: "the slave". Is that to say he is not a slave at the end of six? And the following is its interpretation: if he said it at the beginning of six, etc... it might enter your mind [that it means] actually at the beginning of six [years of service]; let him derive [it from the fact] that we require [him to say] "I love my ... wife and my children", and at the beginning of six he does not yet have a wife and children, since [the master] has not yet given over to him a Canaanite maidservant.

ה"ג אמר רבא בתחילת פרוטה אחרונה בסוף פרוטה אחרונה - ול"ג לא קשיא ול"ג כאן. והכי פירושו כל תחילת שש דקתני כשמגיע להתחיל לסוף פרוטה אחרונה לפי חשבון גרעונה שעדיין עליו שוה פרוטה דהוי דמי עבד וכל סוף שש (פרוטה אחרונה) מאחר שהתחיל בה נקרא סוף דלאו עבד הוא דאין עליו שוה פרוטה וה"ק אמר בתחילת שש קודם פרוטה אחרונה דכבר יש לו אשה ובנים ולא בסוף שש לאחר שהתחיל פרוטה אחרונה אינו נרצע ואפי' אמר ושנה דכתיב לא אצא חפשי סמוך ליציאה וכל זמן שיש עליו פרוטה שלימה לאו סמוך ליציאה הוא אי אמר ושנה בסוף פרוטה אחרונה ולא אמר בתחילת פרוטה אחרונה אינו נרצע שנאמר אם יאמר העבד עד שיאמר כשהוא עבד ובלשון אחרת גירסא זו בפי כל ואיני יכול להעמידה שהרבה תשובות בה וזה הלשון אמר יאמר עד שיאמר וישנה העבד עד שיאמר כשהוא עבד אמר בתחילת שש ולא אמר בסוף שש אינו נרצע שנאמר אם אמר יאמר אמר בסוף שש ולא אמר בתחילת שש אינו נרצע שנאמר לא אצא חפשי והכי פירושו אמר בתחילת שש פעם אחת ולא חזר ואמר בסוף שש אינו נרצע דבעינן אמר יאמר שתי אמירות אמר בסוף שש ולא אמר בתחילת שש אינו נרצע שנאמר לא אצא חפשי וזה כבר יצא השתא קשיא לי טובא הא נמי תיפוק לי מאמר יאמר דהא לא אמר ושנה ואם באת לפרש אמר בסוף שש שתי פעמים א"כ לא דמיא לרישא דאי אומר בתחילת שש שתי פעמים מנא ליה דאינו נרצע ועוד מה לי דשבקיה לדרשה קמייתא דדריש העבד עד שיאמר כשהוא עבד ונקיט ליה קרא אחרינא מלא אצא והרי כבר יצא תיפוק ליה מהעבד:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:2)


לא כלום אמר ליה - דכיון דקנה עבד קנה רבו:


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 23b:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:3)


ורבנן סברי יש קנין - אם נתנו לו מתנה הואיל ודעת אחרת מקנהו ונותן זה לא גמר בלבו שיזכה בו הרב הויא דעבד ומיפריק ביה על ידי עצמו:


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 23b:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/23b:10:4)

## Daf 24a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:1:1)


אין אשה פודה מעשר שני - קס"ד במעשר שני שהוא משדה בעלה שהיא כבעלה וקרינן ליה ממעשרו וכדמפרש לה ואזיל:


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:1:2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:1:3)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:1)


אלא בזוזי דידה - דנכסי מלוג:


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:2)

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:2:3)


איש אמר רחמנא ולא אשה - איש ממעשרו אמר רחמנא ולא אשה ממעשר בעלה דאשה כאחר דמיא:



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:3:1

ע"מ שתפדי בו כו' - שתהיה כאיש אחר לפדות בלא חומש רבנן סברי כי אמר לה קני קנה ליה בעלה וכי אמר לה ע"מ לאו כלום הוא הילכך זוזי הוו נמי דבעל ושליחותיה עבדא איש ממעשרו קרינא ביה ורבי מאיר סבר לדידה גופה לא אקני לה אלא להכי שתהא כאיש אחר לפדות בלא חומש:



### Line 4

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:4:1)

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 24a:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/24a:4:2)

## Daf 26a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:1:1)


אי נמי - משכחת לה הגבהה אצל פיל:


Alternatively - lifting an elephant is possible...


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:1:2)


בחבילי זמורות - הגבוהים מן הארץ שלשה טפחים ומוליכין עליהם דהגבהת שלשה טפחים הגבהה היא דנפקא ליה מתורת לבוד:


Using bundles of vines - which are three *tefakhim* high, and one leads [the elephant] onto them. [This is effective] because lifting three *tefakhim* is considered lifting, which is derived from the law of *lavud* (Shabbat 97a:17).



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:1)


מתני' שיש להם אחריות - היינו קרקעות שאחריות כל אדם הלוה והנושה בחבירו עליהן לפי שקיימין ועומדין לפיכך נסמכין עליהן:


MISHNA: Property that serves as a guarantee - namely, land, because the surety of everyone -- the borrower and the one who lends to his friend -- is upon it, since it lasts and persists. Therefore, people rely on it.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:2)


בחזקה - רפק ביה פורתא או דיש אמצרי או נעל או פרץ כל שהוא:


By taking possession - if he hoed it a little (Bava Batra 54b:3), or walked upon its boundaries (Bava Kamma 9a:3), or fenced it or breached [its fence] even a bit (Bava Batra 42a:9).


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:2:3)


נקנין עם נכסים כו' - אם מכר מטלטלין עם קרקע כיון שקנה לוקח את הקרקע באחד משלשה קנינים נקנים מטלטלין עמה:


Can be acquired along with property etc. - if one sold movable objects along with land. The moment that the buyer acquires the land using one of the three methods of acquisition, the movable objects are acquired along with it.



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:3:1)


וזוקקים - נכסים הללו שאין להם אחריות דקמיירי בהו תנא את הנכסים שיש להן כו'. אע"ג דאין נשבעין על הקרקעות לבדן כדנפקא לן בשבועות (דף מב:) היכא דטענו כלים וקרקעות ונתחייב לישבע על המטלטלין זוקקין המטלטלין את הקרקעות לישבע עליהן האי זוקקין אנכסים קאי שאין להם אחריות ולאו אבית דין:


And this property that does not serve as a guarantee **binds** the property that serves as a, etc. Even though one normally does not take an oath concerning land alone -- as we derive in Shevuot (Shevuot 42b:12) -- where the claim included vessels and land, and one is required to take an oath concerning the movable objects, the movable objects bind the land so that an oath must also be taken regarding [the land]. This [verb] "binds" refers to the property that does not serve as a guarantee, and does not [refer] to the court [as a subject of the verb].

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:4:1)


גמ' ואימא עד דאיכא שטר - בהדי כסף דכתיב קרא (ירמיהו ל״ב:מ״ד) וכתוב בספר וחתום:



### Line 5

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:5:1

לא שנו - דקני בכספא לחודיה אלא במקום שאין רגילין לכתוב שטר מכירה:


They taught - that [land] can be acquired by means of money alone only in a place where it is not customary to write a bill of sale.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:5:2)


לא קנה - דכיון דרגילין בהכי לא סמכא דעתיה דלוקח עד דנקיט שטרא ועיקר דעתו לקנות על השטר הוא:


One does not acquire - since it is customary [to write documents], the buyer does not rely [on the sale being valid] until he takes the document; his primary intention is to acquire by means of the document.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:5:3)


ואם פריש - אם רצוני יקנה לי כספי או יקנה שטרי:


And if he specified - whether my intention is that my money effects the acquisition or my document effects the acquisition.



### Line 6

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:6:1)


אי בעינא כו' - להכי אמר תרוייהו שיהא הוא יכול לחזור בו אבל המוכר לא יחזור כדמפרש ואזיל שאם בא המוכר לחזור יאמר לו אני רוצה שיקנה לי כספי ואם הוא בא לחזור יאמר לו איני רוצה שיהא כספי קונה עד שיבא השטר וכל זמן שלא קבלתי השטר אחזור בי:


If I wish etc. - for this reason he stated both: so that he would be able to retract [his participation in the sale]. But the seller cannot retract, as it goes on to elaborate: if the seller would want to retract, he would say to him: "I want my money to effect the acquisition." And if [Rav Idi bar Avin] would want to retract, [Rav Idi] would say to him: "I don't want my money to effect the acquisition until the document arrives; as long as I haven't received the document, I can retract."

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:7:1)


את ספר המקנה - אלמא יש קנין אף בספר לבדו:


"The deed of purchase" - so we see that there is a purchase even with a deed alone.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 26a:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/26a:7:2)


עד שיתן דמים - דלא גמר מוכר ומקנה עד דקביל דמים ואע"ג דקביל דמים בעי שטרא אלא היכא דפריש וכדאמרינן לעיל:


Until [the buyer] gives [the seller] money - since the sale is not complete, and does not effect acquisition, until the money is received. And even if the money is received, the document is required, unless [the buyer] specifies [otherwise], as we have stated above.

It is thereby sold or given - [at this point, the Gemara] assumes that [the *baraita*] is teaching that [the seller wrote in the document] either [the "selling" formulation] or [the "giving" formulation].

Due to its poor quality - he prefers to effect the transfer to the buyer by means of a document so that he will not have the opportunity to retract.

He could answer - don't raise an objection to me from the *mishna*, because the *tanna* of the *mishna* is referring to an ordinance of the Rabbis. The Rabbis abrogated acquisition through money, and said that acquisition takes place only through pulling. ## Daf 28a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:1)


שלא ניתנה ליתבע - שבועה שלה בעד אחד כדאמרינן התם (ריש סוטה) דצריך שני עדים שראוה שנסתרה דיליף דבר דבר מממון:


Where it cannot be demanded - [that is, where] her oath cannot [be imposed] by one witness, as is stated there: that two witnesses who saw that she secluded herself are required, which is derived from [the word] "matter" (Deuteronomy 19:15) [concerning the *halakhot* of monetary matters and the same word for] "matter" (Deuteronomy 24:1) [concerning the *sota*]. (Sotah 3b:19)


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:2)


ממון שניתן ליתבע - להשביע בעד אחד אם טענו מנה וכפר לו בכולו ועד אחד מעידו שהוא חייב לו נשבע שנאמר לא יקום עד אחד באיש לכל עון ולכל חטאת לכל עון ולכל חטאת אינו קם אבל קם הוא לשבועה (שבועות דף מ.):


Money, where it can be demanded - to impose an oath by [the testimony of] one witness: if he claimed a *maneh*, and [the defendant] denied it entirely, and one witness testifies that he is liable, he must swear, as it is stated: "A single witness may not validate against an [accused] party any guilt or blame" (Deuteronomy 19:15) -- it is for any iniquity or for any sin that he may not rise up, but he may rise up to [render one liable to] take an oath. (Shevuot 40a:10)


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:1:3)


אינו דין שמגלגלין - את שבועתו להשביע בגלגול:


Is it not logical that one can extend - his oath, to require him to take an oath by way of extension?



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:1)


אשכחן ודאי - שמגלגלין שבועה טענת ברי בדבר שאין חייבין עליו שבועה כגון קרקעות או שלא הודה במקצת שמגלגלין אותו אם נתחייב לו שבועה ממקום אחר:


We found in the case of a definite [claim] - that we extend the oath [in the case of a] definite claim to a case for which an oath would not be required. For instance, regarding land, or [regarding non-land cases] in which [the defendant] did not partially concede -- we would extend an oath [to these cases] if he were liable to take an oath in a different matter.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:2)


ספק מנין - טענת שמא כגון שבועת השותפין והאריסין שחלקו דתנן בשבועות (דף מה.) חלקו השותפין והאריסין אינו יכול להשביעו וקתני נתחייב לו שבועה ממקום אחר מגלגלין עליו את הכל אלמא ספק נמי מגלגלין:


From where do we derive [that this halakha of the extension of an oath applies also to] uncertain [claims] - Uncertain claims: for instance, the oaths of partners and sharecroppers who [already] divided [the common property]. As is stated in a *mishna* in Shevuot: "Once the partners or the sharecroppers have divided [the common property, each taking his share], then one side may not require an oath of the other [absent a definite claim]" (Shevuot 45a:10). It further states: "but if an oath was imposed upon him due to some other situation, that oath can be extended to impose upon him any [other oath]." Consequently [in the case of] uncertain [claims] we also extend [the requirement to take an oath].


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:2:3)


מנלן - אי מק"ו לא דמי דסוטה כל שבועתה ספק וגלגול נמי ספק ממון עיקר שבועתו אינו באה אלא בטענת ודאי דכתיב (שמות כ״ב:ו׳) כי יתן איש ושבועת השותפין תקנתא דרבנן היא משום דמורו בה היתירא כדאמר התם (שבועות דף מח:) וכיון דעיקר שבועת ממון ליתא אלא בטענת ודאי גלגול דידיה נמי בטענת ודאי ולא בטענת ספק:


From where to we derive - if from an *a fortiori* argument [from the oath of a *sota*, the cases] are not comparable, since her oath is entirely due to uncertain claims. But as for extension [of an oath] even to uncertain monetary claims -- his essential [requirement to take an] oath only comes about due to a definite claim, as it is stated: "When any party gives" (Exodus 22:6) ["... the owner of the house shall depose before God and deny laying hands on the other’s property"]. The oath of partners is an ordinance of the Rabbis, since [otherwise partners] would rationalize taking liberties with [the property for which they are responsible], as is stated there (Shevuot 48b:12). Since the fundamental [requirement to take an] oath in monetary cases is only [in cases of] definite claims, [the cases to which an oath may be] extended from them must also be definite claims and not uncertain claims.

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:9:2

Once he acquires - [that is, once] the seller [acquires] it and pulls one *zuz* from the buyer under the rubric of *khalipin* acquisition, the buyer is responsible for any accidents that happen to the exchanged property, wherever they are -- whether they died or got lost -- [the buyer is still] required to pay [the rest of] the money which he agreed to give him. This is because when the seller pulls the scarf or the *zuz* under the rubric of *khalipin*, the goods are acquired by the buyer, wherever they may be.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:9:3)


החליף שור בפרה - כיון שמשך בעל הפרה את השור נקנית פרה ללוקח בכל מקום שהיא ואונסיה עליו ובגמרא פריך מאי כיצד הואיל והוא אתי לאשמועינן דמטבע נעשה חליפין שאע"פ שבתורת דמים קיימא לן (בב"מ דף מד.) דמעות אינן קונות אלא משיכת המקח כי יהבינהו ניהליה בתורת קנין סודר קני כי סודר הוה ליה למיתני כיצד החליף מעות בפרה:


If one exchanges an ox for a cow - once the owner of the cow [i.e., the buyer] pulls the ox, the cow is acquired by the buyer wherever it may be, and any accidents are his responsibility. The *gemara* will ask what is meant by [the term] "how so", since [it appeared as if the *mishna*] was coming to teach us that a coin could be used for *khalipin* exchange. Even though, if [the coin is given] under the rubric of money, we have established that money does not effect acquisition (Bava Metzia 44a), but only pulling of the goods does -- nevertheless, if he gives him [the coin] under the rubric of "scarf acquisition", the acquisition takes effect just as it would have with an actual scarf. Therefore, the *mishna* should have read: "how so? If one exchanges money for a cow."



### Line 10

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:1)


גמ' מאי ניהו מטבע - שהוא הניתן דמים באחר בכל מקום ואשמועינן מתני' דאע"ג דבתורת דמים קיימא לן דלא קני כי יהביה ליה בתורת חליפין קני:


GEMARA: What is the [item given in exchange]? [If it is referring to] a coin - ["a coin" in the sense of] that which is usually given as money in exchange for something else, and the *mishna* is teaching us that although if it had been given under the rubric of money, which we have already established does not effect acquisition -- but if he gave it to him under the rubric of *khalipin* exchange it does effect acquisition.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:2)


שמע מינה כו' - ואנן קיימא לן בפרק הזהב (ב"מ דף מו.) דאין מטבע נעשה חליפין:


One can learn from it, etc. - and we have established in Chapter "The Gold" that a coin cannot be used in a *khalipin* exchange. (Bava Metzia 46a:5)


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 28a:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/28a:10:3)


אמר רב יהודה הכי קאמר כל הנישום דמים באחר - כל דבר שאם בא לתתו דמים באחר צריך לשומו בדמים דהיינו כל המטלטלין בר ממטבע:


Rav Yehuda said: this is what it is saying: With regard to all items that can be appraised when used as monetary value for another item - any item that, if one intended to use it as money to give in return for another item, it would be necessary to appraise its monetary value -- that is, any movable object other than a coin.

## Daf 31a


### Line 1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:1:1)

**As she persuades him (*meshadalto*):** She entices him; as we translate (Onkelos on Exodus 22:15), "And if a man entices," as *Arei yeshadal*.



### Line 2

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:2:1)


והארץ הדום רגלי - והעובר בסתר אומר אין המקום כאן לפיכך הוא נסתר לומר אין יודע נמצא כדוחק רגליו ומקצרו לומר אין כאן:


**"And the earth is My footstool":** So one who transgresses in private is saying the Omnipresent is not here. Hence he is hidden, saying, "He does not know." It comes out that it is as though he is pushing away His feet and shortening Him, saying, "[He is] not here."



### Line 3

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:3:1)


מלא כל הארץ - משמע משתרבב ויורד למטה והזוקף קומתו נראה כדוחק:


**"The entire world is full":** It implies that He extends and descends below. So one who stands with an upright posture appears as [if he] is pushing [God] away.



### Line 4

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:4:1)

**He said this to him:** Rabbi Yehoshua answered him in the [same] way that Rabbi Eliezer answered him.

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:5:1

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:2)

**From your eyelashes:** [These are] the hairs in the rows of eyelids. It is evident that you were orphaned, so your eyelashes fell out due to the crying. As it as we say [in Sanhedrin] (104b), "And Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel heard her voice and cried with her until his eyelashes fell out.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:3)

**That you are the son of a widow** And that you do not need [my answer] in practice. Rather you have come to learn, and I tell you that the honor of both of them is the same upon you.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:5:4)


הטל להם מים בספל וקעקע - קרקר להם כמו שמקרקרין לתרנגולים ולפי שלא היה צריך לעשות והוא שאלו כמו שעליו לעשות אמר לי אבא ואימא השיבו בלשון שחוק:


**Pour water for them into a pitcher and squawk:** Crow to them, as we crow to chickens. And since he did not need to do [this in practice], but he asked him as if he had to do [it] - "my mother and father said" - [Rabbi Yehoshua] answered him with a jocular expression.



### Line 7

###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:7:1)


חזרו והודו למאמרות הראשונות - כ"ש שחייב אדם בכבודו שאף הוא שותף בבריאתו כאביו ואמו וחייו ומותו מסורין בידו:


**They returned and conceded about the first statements:** All the more so is one obligated in His honor. For, like his father and his mother, He too is a partner in one's creation; and his life and death are given over to His hands.


###### Rashi on Kiddushin 31a:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Kiddushin/r/31a:7:2)

**"The beginning of Your word is truth":** Scripture was not required to say, "The beginning of Your word is truth," except because they were speaking ill about His first statements, saying He is warning about His [own] honor; but afterwards when they heard the end of His words, they returned and conceded - they learned that the beginning of His words were true.
